Name: Rainbow Deck
Draw: A repeating lattice of cut diamonds set into a near-black ground: four diamonds across with the rows running on to the top and bottom edges, each the same faceted brilliant-cut stone sitting on the same grid. Each diamond is a clear, smoky stone that breaks the light into a soft, muted rainbow: dusky orange, dull gold, sage green, slate blue and faded purple, taken from the dark end of each ramp and lying in narrow bands across the facets rather than filling them, so the stone reads first as a diamond and only second as a rainbow. The colors are quiet and greyed, never neon or candy-bright; the only bright points are small near-white glints on the upper-left facets, and the lower pavilion falls to deep smoky violet. Thin dark antique-gold lines run between them like the setting of a jeweled panel, so the back reads as one calm, even pattern rather than as stones scattered on a cloth.

Name: Blue Diamond Deck
Draw: A repeating lattice of cut blue diamonds set into a near-black ground: four diamonds across with the rows running on to the top and bottom edges, each the same faceted brilliant-cut stone sitting on the same grid, deep blue at the core and pale icy blue toward the crown, with crisp near-white glints on the upper-left facets and dark navy in the lower pavilion. Thin dark silver lines run between them like the setting of a jeweled panel, so the back reads as one cool, even pattern rather than as stones scattered on a cloth.
